# Air by WZRD

> Air is your personal, creative composable computer: one persistent AI agent with its own workspace, memory, skills, supported app connections, and Mini Apps.

Canonical site: https://air.wzrd.tech

## What Air does

- Runs one durable managed computer per user.
- Keeps useful context continuous across iMessage and web.
- Uses persistent memory, files, browser, terminal, skills, and supported model providers.
- Connects to a catalog of 1,000+ app toolkits; individual availability and permissions vary.
- Creates and runs focused Mini Apps.
- Pauses connecting, sending, publishing, spending, and other consequential actions for human approval.

## Availability

- Ubuntu compute: private beta.
- Omarchy: coming soon.
- Apple-silicon macOS: coming soon; hardware and regional capacity vary.
- Mini App publishing: private beta.
- Mini App monetization: rolling out.
- Agent mesh networking and Tailscale support: exploring / roadmap.

## Important limits

- Air offers a curated supported-model catalog, not 1,000+ AI models.
- Included usage is metered and subject to safety, fair-use, and infrastructure limits.
- The current website preorder form collects no payment.
- All product previews and plans should be read with their visible availability labels.
